newsitem.title: USA: ARCO takes all July crude nominations on Line 63.
newsitem.headline: ARCO takes all July crude nominations on Line 63.

text.p: ARCO Pipeline Co will not proration July nominations on its California Line 63 crude oil pipeline from oil fields in the Central Valley south to Los Angeles refineries, a company spokesman said Wednesday.
"We're not in proration," said John Thom, ARCO spokesman.
He declined to disclose volumes nominated for July, citing company policy.

July marks the fourth straight month ARCO will take all crude shipped on the 118-mile line, which is rated to carry 120,000 barrels per day (bpd) of light crude but typically moves 105,000 to 110,000 bpd of mixed light and heavy grades.
ARCO Pipeline is a unit of Atlantic Richfield Co.
